Photo guidelines:

-Full-height photo (head to toe visible)
-Standing naturally facing the camera
-Arms relaxed by your sides
-Good lighting
-Fitted clothing, activewear, leggings and a fitted top, swimwear, or similar
-If you are not comfortable in swimwear, a sports outfit is perfectly fine
-Avoid oversized clothing, jackets, coats, or loose dresses
